name: Sanamahi
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Sanamahi works to give delta households and water councils a voice in Lothal’s changing government. The proposed reforms turn obligations over flood relief, inventories and communal repairs into matters of public law. The University register proposes a connection to Lothal’s Factory Drainage Dispute and Lothal Guild Settlement. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
